args.title: Document API limits for report fields in the reference
args.body:
File: src/api/errors.ts

Add documentation in the API reference about the validation limits for report fields such as the maximum number of recipients, maximum length of report names, and maximum number of categories. This will inform users about the deliberate limits previously causing "validation failed" errors, allowing clients to check inputs before sending requests.
